description: Rochester, NY - Today, the Civil Service Employees Association (CSEA) endorsed Joe Morelle’s candidacy for the 25th Congressional District. CSEA represents over 300,000 active and retired, public and private sector employees, including approximately 45,000 members in Western Region 6 which serves Monroe County.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY JOE MORELLE FOR CONGRESS bottom of page
title: CSEA Endorses Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
